capabilities: Index markdown checkboxes across configured context folders or the whole vault
Group, sort, and filter tasks in a central dashboard list
Show smart lists for dates (Overdue, Today, Soon) and configured tags
Edit task lines inline via panel controls and a right-click menu on any task line
Attach optional per-task detail sidecar notes that backlink to the source line
extras: README states the plugin makes no network requests and writes only to acted-on task lines and detail notes; manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Think Things, Todoist, or TickTick, but pointed at the notes you already have instead of a silo
problem: Most task plugins force you to adopt a new system or move tasks into dedicated files with metadata blocks, instead of working with checkboxes already scattered through your notes.

relations.evidence: If you (or the Tasks plugin) write metadata as Dataview inline fields instead of emoji, Taskgregator reads those

summary: Task dashboard that aggregates existing markdown checkboxes into navigator, task-list, and context-sidebar views organized by project, person, and date.
